text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Model-serving kernel mismatch caused fallback to CPU execution in us-central, yielding elevated latencies and some 504s starting 03:40 UTC. Affected ~0.5-2% of hosted generation requests. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2410012345

olivia.sre: spotting repeated kernel version errors on gpu-host-11; drivers rejecting optimized kernels, runtime falling back to slower CPU path. p99 spiked.

ben.eng: confirmed recent kernel patch (kernel-5.19.12->5.19.14) on a subset of nodes changed ABI for CUDA_SYM lookup. rolling back kernel on affected pool now.

olivia.sre: cordoning host group ai-pool-b and shifting new requests to ai-pool-a at 03:44 UTC.

deploy-bot: Action recorded: kernel rollback triggered by ben.eng on hosts [gpu-11,gpu-12] @ 03:46 UTC.

rachel.support: drafting external note: "We're investigating increased latencies and intermittent timeouts in US-CENTRAL due to a runtime fallback to CPU on some GPU hosts. Mitigation in progress." Publish after stabilization?

ben.eng: rollback applied @ 03:49 UTC, restarting inference service. observed kernels now loading; error counts dropping.

olivia.sre: error rate trending down to ~0.3% at 03:56 UTC. letting caches and warm-up ramp. monitoring for 10m stable window.

minh.pm: ETA for full recovery? execs want a short summary for leadership.

olivia.sre: estimate 15m for steady state once warm-up finishes. will update when errors <0.25% for 5m.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] Metrics returned to baseline (~0.18%) at 04:05 UTC. Mitigation summary: rolled back kernel on affected GPU hosts, cordoned and drained affected pool, routed traffic to healthy hosts. No customer data loss. Postmortem scheduled 2026-04-05 14:30 UTC in #incidents-postmortems. Runbook: https://status.redwood.ai/runbooks/gpu-kernel-fallback

rachel.support: customer note posted and shared with account teams. follow-up comms will include mitigation and next steps.

minh.pm: thanks team — please add timeline, kernel diff, and suggested guardrails (canary kernel rollout + runtime compatibility check) to the postmortem. Owners: olivia.sre (ops timeline), ben.eng (root cause & fix), rachel.support (customer comms). :white_check_mark:
